Getting more inquiries

1. Show the room in good light
Bright, clear photos of the room, the bed, the CR and the entrance help renters decide before they visit.

2. Keep availability up to date
Update your listing when a room or bed fills up, so renters only message you about free ones.

3. Reply soon
Renters often contact a few places at once. A quick text goes a long way.
